40101.notes: Oklahoma tax-deed resale county. Muskogee County Treasurer holds the statutory June tax resale after the certificate period (68 O.S.). 2026 resale referenced for June 8, 2026 (Muskogee Civic Center, 425 Boston St.; payoff to remove from sale often by ~9:00 AM sale morning — confirm). Research lists via oktaxrolls.com/county/Muskogee and Treasurer (918-682-0811). Distinct from weekly mortgage-style Sheriff sales. Resale deed is the investor deed path after multi-year delinquency; environmental and flood DD still required near the Arkansas River.

40101.survivingLiens: Tax resale deed after statutory process generally cuts off most junior private liens; federal liens can survive. Always verify sale type (resale vs sheriff mortgage sale).

42037.notes: Pennsylvania Tax Claim Bureau county (upset then judicial sale path). Columbia County (Bloomsburg) Tax Claim Bureau — 11 West Main Street, Main Street County Annex, Bloomsburg; 570-389-5642 / cctaxoffice@columbiapa.org. Upset sales historically early September via Bid4Assets (bid4assets.com/columbiapaupset) with ~$500 deposit + processing fee pattern; 2025 upset ran Sept 8–9 online. Upset buyers take subject to many liens; judicial sale is the free-and-clear path for unsolds. County website SSL issues have occurred — prefer direct Bureau contact and Bid4Assets notices. University (Bloomsburg) and light industrial submarkets differ from rural townships.
42037.auctionFormat: Online upset sale (Bid4Assets) plus later judicial sale for unsolds

auctionPlatform.label: Bid4Assets — Columbia County PA Upset Sale

42037.auctionFrequency: Upset sale annually in September (statutory window 2nd Monday of September through Sept 30); judicial sales as scheduled for remaining inventory
42037.depositRules: Upset sale historically requires a single ~$500 deposit plus platform processing fee via Bid4Assets before bidding. Certified check/money order terms appear in Bureau notices for some cycles. Confirm current deposit, balance deadline, and judicial-sale rules with the Tax Claim Bureau before funding.
42037.survivingLiens: Upset sale: property typically remains subject to many liens. Judicial sale: designed to free the property of most liens. Federal tax liens can survive either path. Always identify which sale type applies.
42037.quietTitle: Judicial sale judgments often support marketable title; upset-sale purchasers frequently need a later judicial sale or quiet title to clear liens.

49021.notes: Utah tax-deed county with a strong online May sale. Iron County (Cedar City) Auditor runs the annual tax sale exclusively on Public Surplus — 2026 sale Thursday May 28, 2026, 10:00 AM MT (same-day item closes). Per-property credit-card deposits: $50 if tax value ≤ $10,000; $100 if higher. Winning bidders wire full payment within 5 business days (2026: by June 4). Property list, terms, disclaimer, and GIS map on ironcountyut.gov/auditor/tax-sale. No post-sale redemption once auctioned (4-year delinquency threshold before sale). SUU/university and I-15 growth shape Cedar City demand; rural west desert tracts are a different risk profile.

34033.notes: New Jersey municipal tax-lien county — sales are NOT run by Salem County government. Each municipality’s tax collector holds the annual tax sale under N.J.S.A. 54:5-19 (often online via RealAuction/RealTaxLien or in-person). Pennsville is the largest municipality; also research Salem City, Carneys Point, Penns Grove, Pittsgrove, etc. Confirm with each municipal tax collector or the Salem County Board of Taxation. Investor path is certificate purchase then Superior Court in rem foreclosure after statutory wait (minimum 2 years framework). Industrial riverfront, flood, and environmental DD are material in Delaware River towns.
